name: cybersus
source:
A cartoon comedy visual novel about an introvert's quest to escape from complete social isolation by making new friends in a gloomy floating utopia! Filled with awkward conversations, obscure drama and quirky sexuality.

[From [url=https://portrait-prophecies.itch.io/cybersus]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部卡通喜剧视觉小说，讲述了一个内向的人通过在阴暗的漂浮乌托邦结交新朋友来摆脱完全的社会孤立的故事！充满了尴尬的对话、晦涩的戏剧和古怪的性行为。

[来自[url=https://portrait-prophecies.itch.io/cybersus]itch.io[/url]]
